question: With which Indian dance form was Guru Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair associated?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kathakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Guru Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair was a legendary exponent of the Indian classical dance form **Kathakali**.
 
• **Kathakali** is one of the most renowned forms of Indian classical dance and is native to the state of **Kerala**.
 
• This dance form is characterized by its elaborate costumes, intricate makeup, and detailed facial expressions, which are integral to storytelling.
